jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a skilled Chartered Accountant with expertise in the real estate and construction sectors to join our team in the Delhi-NCR region. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial management, compliance, and reporting, specifically tailored to the unique challenges of the real estate and construction industries. As a Chartered Accountant, you will be responsible for managing financial records, preparing financial statements, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations. You will play a crucial role in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis, providing insights that will drive strategic decision-making within the organization. Key responsibilities include: - Preparing and reviewing financial statements and reports in accordance with accounting standards. - Conducting audits and ensuring compliance with tax regulations and financial reporting requirements. - Collaborating with project managers and stakeholders to provide financial insights and support for ongoing projects. - Assisting in the preparation of budgets and forecasts, monitoring financial performance against targets. - Advising on financial implications of business decisions and strategies within the real estate and construction sectors. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex financial information clearly. Proficiency in accounting software and a solid understanding of financial regulations in the real estate and construction industries are essential. If you are a proactive and detail-oriented Chartered Accountant looking to make a significant impact in the real estate and construction sectors, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

jobs_results.description:
At Aristocrat, we are passionate about crafting world-class gaming experiences that entertain millions of people across the globe. Our mission is to lead by example in the global gaming industry, encouraging an inclusive and innovative culture that values outstanding talent and creativity. Aristocrat is looking for a Supply Chain Accountant to join our outstanding team! This role is a critical part of our Global Supply Chain Finance team and will support the financial accounting of our integration centers. 
 
What You'll Do 
 
• Perform month-end close activities including preparation of journal entries, Balance Sheet reconciliations, and account analysis. 
 
• Prepare and upload annual standard costs into Microsoft Dynamics 365 
 
• Monitor and analyze integration center costs, standard costs, and production variances, providing regular performance reporting and insights. 
 
• Provide accounting guidance to both accounting and non-accounting colleagues 
 
• Support personnel at integration centers and their associated business unit management with ad hoc accounting information and analysis 
 
• Prepare audit support and documentation for internal and external auditors 
 
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and company policies. 
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the finance and supply chain departments. 
 
• Provide insights and recommendations for process improvements. 
 
What We're Looking For 
 
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting 
 
• More than 3 years of accounting experience, ideally within a supply chain setting 
 
• Proven track record of success in financial analysis and reporting 
 
• Strong knowledge of accounting principles and practices 
 
• Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills 
 
• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities 
 
• Proficiency in accounting software (Microsoft Dynamics 365 preferred) and Microsoft Office Suite 
 
• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, xlookups, sumifs, etc.) 
 
• Capacity to work autonomously and collaboratively with others 
 
• Diligent with a dedication to maintaining flawless accuracy 
 
• Ambitious approach with a drive to compete and excel in a dynamic environment. 
 
About Us: Aristocrat and Aristocrat Gaming 
 
Aristocrat is an Australia-based entertainment and content-creation company powered by technology to deliver world-leading mobile and casino games, entertaining millions of people across the globe daily. The Aristocrat organisation includes three prestigious business units: Aristocrat Gaming, Product Madness, and Aristocrat Interactive. As an award-winning organization, we thank our wonderful people for earning us numerous prestigious honors and recognitions. 
 
Aristocrat understands that keeping you engaged and excited about your professional setting is the ultimate fuel for our success and creativity, and we strive to keep your best interests our top priority. In addition to competitive pay, we're proud to offer world-class benefits, flexible work environments, and a workplace that is unparalleled. Apply today and take your career on a journey of fascinating tomorrows. 
 
Aristocrat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. 
 
We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. Diversity and Inclusion are integral to our values of Talent Unleashed, Collective Brilliance, Good Business, Good Citizen, and It's All About the Player. 
 
Additional Information 
 
Depending on the nature of your role, you may be required to register with the Nevada Gaming Control Board (NGCB) and/or other gaming jurisdictions in which we operate. 
 
This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat. 
 
 Compensation Philosophy 
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. 
 
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits. 
 
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

jobs_results.title: R2R Accountant
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented R2R Accountant to join our finance team in the Delhi-NCR region. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the Record to Report (R2R) process, ensuring accurate and timely monthly closing activities. This role requires proficiency in SAP and a strong understanding of accounting principles to facilitate effective financial reporting and compliance. Key Responsibilities: - Oversee the monthly closing process, ensuring all financial transactions are recorded accurately and in a timely manner. - Prepare and review journal entries, reconciliations, and financial statements to ensure compliance with accounting standards. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather necessary data for financial reporting and analysis. - Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports. - Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency of the R2R process. - Support audits by providing necessary documentation and explanations as required. Required Skills: - Strong knowledge of R2R processes and financial accounting principles. - Proficiency in SAP for financial reporting and analysis. - Experience with monthly closing activities and financial reconciliations. - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. - Strong attention to detail and ability to work under tight deadlines. - Effective communication skills to collaborate with various stakeholders. If you are a motivated individual with a passion for finance and accounting, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to contribute to our team.
